messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — NovaRetail renewal in 14 days. NPS dipped to 6 last week and weekly active teams flattened. Usage heatmap: onboarding checklist completion is 60% -> lots of partial setups.
Ethan (CSM): Ugh. They pinged me yesterday about slow imports and one of their power users said outputs look 'noisy'.
Sophie (Enablement): Can we run a 30m focused session + a short checklist audit? If they complete core tasks their LTV historically increases.
Rohit (RevOps): Renewal talk will surface pricing. We should prepare a downgrade-safe offer (feature-gated) vs a short-term discount. Avoid full churn discounts.
Maya (CS): I want a quick operational fix too — import errors might be the blocker. @OnboardBot did we get import failure alerts for NovaRetail?
OnboardBot: import_task failed for customer:nova-retail at 2024-09-16T09:04:12Z. Error: "KV cache overflow during workspace import". See log: ```ERR KV_CACHE_ALLOC 0x2bfa ...```
Maya (CS): Perfect — that's actionable. Propose we pair on a three-part micro-play: 1) Ops patch + rollback window, 2) Guided enablement blitz, 3) Targeted save offer (3mo discount + staged downgrade path). Calling it "churn trifecta" for this account.
Ethan (CSM): Love it. Quick notes: outreach script should emphasize prevention of data loss, guarantee of a no-cost migration window, and a 1:1 enablement session. Keep it short.
Sophie (Enablement): I'll draft the session agenda: 10m intro, 10m walkthrough of checklist gaps, 10m Q&A + playbook links. Also record and attach follow-up clips.
Rohit (RevOps): I'll prototype a contract amendment: 3 months at 20% off, with an opt-in downgrade path that preserves export access and audit logs. If they churn within 60 days we offer a one-time reactivation credit.
Maya (CS): Owners + deadlines: Ops patch by EOD tomorrow (Rohit loop in infra?), Enablement session scheduled within 3 business days (owner Sophie), Outreach email and contract draft by EOD today (owner Ethan).
Rohit (RevOps): I'll ping infra. @Ethan I'll attach the proposed amendment to the renewal thread and mark it as "save-offer-v1".
Ethan (CSM): Drafted outreach subject lines: "Prevent data hiccups — short session + safe renewal option" and "Quick fix + 3mo save plan for NovaRetail". Which do we prefer?
Sophie (Enablement): Use the first one. More trust-y. Also include a one-click calendar link and checklist snapshot.
Maya (CS): I'll do the first outreach (personal note + link to calendar + mention the import fix). ETA in my calendar today at 17:00 PT. Please react :white_check_mark: when your piece is ready.
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: NovaRetail enablement session draft and invite to be sent at 2024-09-16T17:00:00Z.
Ethan (CSM): Contract amendment uploaded to internal drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/nova/save-offer-v1 (draft). Will iterate after Rohit reviews.
Rohit (RevOps): Reviewed and added legal flags inline. No blocking questions, just one clause about data export retention.
Sophie (Enablement): Session draft ready, recording template attached. I'll schedule provisional invites and wait for Maya outreach to confirm time.
Maya (CS): Cool — I'm sending outreach now. If they accept, plan: run patch, run session, sign amendment. If they push back we escalate to an executive touchpoint next week.
Ethan (CSM): I'll prep a short renewal play doc for the exec if needed.
Maya (CS): Thanks team. Quick checklist in this thread: [ ] Ops patch rolled, [ ] Session scheduled, [ ] Amendment signed, [ ] Follow-up clips sent. We'll reconvene here if any item misses deadline.
Sophie (Enablement): On it.
Rohit (RevOps): On it.
Ethan (CSM): On it.
OnboardBot: Task status update queued: ops_patch -> in_progress.
